knowledge_gaps: The treatment equals the control whenever n <= 12, because the recent-ten window contains every nonterminal target. Report the training-user fraction with n > 12 and the expected fraction of changed draws in each category; short histories appear common.

Allocation documentation remains contradictory: snapshots specify fixed 64/64 branches, while definitions specify Bernoulli(0.75). Reconcile the actual sampler, checkpoint metadata and diagnostic definitions before claiming that cutoff sampling is the only intervention. Web search cannot resolve this local inconsistency.

The four reported selected-checkpoint validation scores average to 0.5975, whereas previous inspirations list combined_score=0.5825. Identify each score's configuration, checkpoint and evaluator provenance before using either as the control result.

Recent cutoffs jointly change target exposure, retained context length and absolute positional exposure under left padding. The experiment estimates the total sampling-policy effect; it cannot establish that reduced stale-interest influence caused any gain.

Reproducibility needs an explicit early-stopping interpretation, complete RNG integration and checkpoint-aligned counters. Shared purpose-specific seeds alone do not guarantee matched negative draws when rejection sampling consumes different numbers of random values.

The report omits the earlier conditional paired-bootstrap plan and a clear distinction between category checkpoint selection and global experimental-arm selection. Select one arm by macro validation HR@10; choosing the better arm separately for each category would change the declared experiment. Any uncertainty interval remains conditional on fitted models and fixed candidates.

Originality 3 and code difficulty 3 are reasonable for a localized sampler change, but future potential 7 is speculative without measuring treatment exposure. Complete this comparison before introducing temporal or textual layers. Add the missing RSS reference and distinguish its sampling policy from the proposed endpoint-preserving policy.

Lower-tail training margins do not specifically support recency sampling. Increased exposure to frequent items, repeated purchases or longer contexts could provide shortcuts; examine these shifts descriptively using training data while keeping host macro validation HR@10 as the sole selection metric.
